reproduction_boundary.protocol_change: Uses the controlled speaker-overlapping 70/15/15 manifests instead of the upstream 90/10 emotion-stratified split.
reproduction_boundary.runtime_adaptations: Uses the existing validated B4 pYIN contour (50-500 Hz, 1024/160 frame-hop) with the upstream raw-Hz zero-unvoiced interpolation behavior because the upstream C2-C7 default pYIN took more than 10 minutes for one 24.7-second utterance. The Wav2Vec2 and pitch encoders use BF16 autocast for the 8 GB CUDA GPU, while cross-attention, fusion, projection, classifier, and loss remain FP32 to prevent mixed-precision optimizer instability. Restores PyTorch Xavier initialization for MultiheadAttention.in_proj_weight because Transformers 4.57 otherwise materializes these checkpoint-missing direct parameters as zeros; this matches the Transformers 4.30-era upstream behavior. Uses num_workers=0 for Windows-safe in-memory Parquet audio access. Training uses validation-balanced-accuracy early stopping with patience 5 and restores the best validation checkpoint. Test is evaluated exactly once after training stops.
